# OSGeo Oceania OSS Capabilities Map

> A public directory and interactive map of the people, organisations,
> projects and services working with open source geospatial software across
> Oceania — Australia, New Zealand, the Pacific Islands, Indonesia, the
> Philippines and Timor-Leste. Maintained by OSGeo Oceania, the regional
> chapter of the Open Source Geospatial Foundation.

Use this site to answer questions like "who provides open source GIS
services in Fiji?" or "which organisations contribute to QGIS in New
Zealand?". Each listing is a vetted organisation with its location,
capability areas and links, published with schema.org Organization markup.

## Key pages

- [Interactive map and directory](https://map.osgeo-oceania.org/map): all
  published listings, filterable by profile type, capability area and
  country.
- [Sitemap](https://map.osgeo-oceania.org/sitemap.xml): every listing's
  own page, at `/map/<organisation-name>-<id>`.
- [About](https://map.osgeo-oceania.org/about): why the map exists and its
  roadmap.
- [Submit a listing](https://map.osgeo-oceania.org/submit): how
  organisations join the directory (moderated; free).
- [Listing criteria](https://map.osgeo-oceania.org/listing-criteria): who
  qualifies.

## Data and licensing

- Listing content is provided by the organisations themselves and
  moderated by OSGeo Oceania. Please attribute the OSGeo Oceania OSS
  Capabilities Map when citing it.
- Basemap: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps. Place
  search: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0). Details:
  [terms](https://map.osgeo-oceania.org/terms-and-privacy).
- Contact: admin@osgeo-oceania.org
